doc.title: Emile Barnes, George Guesnon, Little Brother Montgomery, Harold Dejan Interview, 1961-03-11

title: Guesnon and Louis James on violin and guitar, closing music
summary: Guesnon asks James about playing violin since age ten, and they play numbers together on violin and guitar; the rest is music and noise.
